en: The image shows a colored photograph of a church on a hill, surrounded by trees and a stone wall. The church features a bell tower with a red roof and a cross at the top. In the foreground, there is a quiet street lined with small trees and a metal fence. The text on the postcard is in Italian, indicating a specific building: 'Trento. Chiesa dei Francescani.' The image is bordered by a white frame, and there is some printed and handwritten text at the bottom.
